{{Recipe}}

'''Nigerian smoked fish''' is mostly used in preparing Nigerian [[Cookbook:Soup|soups]], such as okra soup, bitterleaf soup, and ora soup.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Mackerel|Mackerel]] fish
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Skewer|Toothpicks]]
* [[Cookbook:Oven|Oven]]
* [[Cookbook:Grill|Grill]]

== Procedure ==

# Gut the fish and remove the gills. Wash well to remove any residual blood or guts.
# Season the fish with a little bit of salt, and rub in the seasoning.
# Bend the fish into a circle, with the fish tail inside of its mouth. Use a toothpick to secure the fish in this shape.

=== Oven method ===

# Wrap the prepared fish in [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the fish for about 15 minutes.
# Remove the foil from the fish. Set the oven to grill or broil, and [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] the fish for about 10 minutes until browned.

=== Grill method ===

# Grease and preheat the grill.
# Place the prepared fish on the grill, and cook until browned.
